name: smartbaking-workspace
description: Local development orchestration for the SmartBaking Laravel and forecasting services

scripts.dev:services: concurrently --kill-others --names laravel,vite,forecast --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "php apps/web/artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=8000" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev -- --host=127.0.0.1" "uv run --project services/forecasting --locked smartbaking-forecasting-serve"
